summary: Einride AB filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, announcing a proposal for its upcoming AGM to reelect eight current board members and appoint R. Lynn Atchison, replacing Karin Markides who will not stand for reelection. The change follows Einride's recent Nasdaq listing. No deal terms or premium are involved; the filing is a standard board refreshment. What to watch: shareholder approval at the June 30 AGM is likely, but the departure of Markides and addition of Atchison signals a strategic shift in board composition.
